request.message:
Act as the bounded ui_integrator for /workspace/scratch/708e8b7f118e/ui-study/worksets/w17. Read and follow roles/ui_integrator.toml, TASK.md, INPUT.md, RUN-CONTROL.md, ALLOCATION.md, INTEGRATION-DECISION.md, SOURCE-MANIFEST.json, and method/SKILL.md including its full required professional references and integration guidance. Work only in this package and relevant public sources. Do not inspect sibling packages or coordinating release records. Do not create further children.

The primary agent retains source selection, art direction, formal SPEC ownership, consequential decisions, and independent final assembled-product acceptance. I have independently read the selected exact source and viewed its local original cookie-action rendering in light/dark plus the baseline settings product. The selected source has a 350px standard width, identity/time/close header, compact body and separated small primary action. Its exact source relationships and native Tabler/Bootstrap behavior must survive. The public live demo request failed TLS verification; that failure is retained. Do not bypass TLS.

Implement only the settled integration. The mature source is sources/tabler-toast-cookies.html plus sources/shared/components/demo/Toast.astro, related Tabler 1.7.1 tagged revision 07f60c07da13d8ff957a370434b7ef5c86f5ab94. The deployed HTML snapshot identity is separate from that tag and its exact deployment commit is unknown. Copy the MIT notice with the adopted block. Use the already loaded matching Tabler assets and bundled Bootstrap Toast; no dependency, replacement style system, reconstructed surface, new animation, or W1–W3 original construction is authorized.

Product edits are permitted only in app/index.html, app/settings-controller.js, and a new app/save-notification.js if useful. Keep app/settings-store.js, dist/, preview/, source preview, theme/language controls and unrelated navigation unchanged. You may create your checks and original evidence only under evidence/integrator/ and return an INTEGRATOR-REPORT.md at package root. Avoid overlapping writes elsewhere.

The settled composition is toast-container position-fixed top-0 end-0 p-3 with source max width and responsive containment. Preserve header → body → separated action-row, original classes, type, borders, shadow, padding, close interaction and transition. Replace the sample portrait with the native avatar initials fallback FN; identity Fieldnotes. Keep role=status, polite, aria-atomic=true and data-bs-autohide=false. Retain the existing inline save-status as a concise nonduplicating form summary; avoid duplicate announcements. Save completion alone never steals focus; feedback persists until explicit dismissal or a later save event.

Read settings-store.js as the authoritative contract: STORAGE_KEY fieldnotes-settings-v1/schemaVersion 1; subscribeSettings emits invalid, pending, success, error; it owns validation, the 750ms interval, snapshots and storage. Pending has operationId/snapshot, success settings/savedAt/operationId, error snapshot/error/operationId, invalid fieldErrors/draft/operationId. Only actual success authorizes saved wording. The controller owns live form values and save/cancel controls. The notification adapter only renders authoritative events and invokes explicitly requested retries.

Follow the exact decision table for English/Chinese pending, success, error and invalid wording. Pending hides the action and explains saving the submitted version locally. Success hides the action, states the browser-local boundary and actual saved time. Error retains the draft and shows Retry save / 重试保存. Retry calls saveSettings with the failed snapshot, never silently reads a later unrelated draft. Invalid identifies the actual first field, associates errors with fields and moves focus only as needed for rejected-submit recovery. Preserve edits made while pending or after failure. An older operation must not replace newer authoritative feedback. Native close only dismisses feedback; it never cancels persistence. If focused retry/close disappears, restore a sensible initiating control.

Exercise actual visible save, pending edits, success/storage readback, forced one-time failure, retry of the failed snapshot while a newer draft exists, invalid input, dismissal/return, keyboard focus, and stale-result behavior where available. Inspect actual source/local integration renders; keep every capture/check honest and distinct from primary-agent acceptance. Required product conditions are light/en and dark/zh at 1440x900 and 1280x600 plus 390x844 containment. You may focus your checks on the adapter; I will independently cover the full matrix and neighboring settings/header/save areas.

Use the existing primary preview server at http://127.0.0.1:4417/; do not stop it. Browser binary and Python are in RUN-CONTROL.md. Set FONTCONFIG_FILE on each browser process. Retain exact command outputs with support/capture_command.py, and preserve failures/attempts. Save actual view_image results at call sites if you inspect images. Use distinct evidence paths. Return any consequential ambiguity to me and continue independent authorized work. Notify me when code is ready so independent review can begin, then report exact changed files, source relationships retained, checks, viewed evidence, defects/risks and unresolved decisions. Do not declare the formal UI SPEC complete.

attempts.result: collab spawn failed: agent thread limit reached
attempts.capture_kind: Faithful immediate transcription of the actual collaboration tool response; no native backend metadata exposed.
